description:
NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED

We are looking for Lead GenAI Engineer as a Full Time for our IT Company.

Location- Remote

Experience- 10+ years

Budget- As per company standard

Notice Period- Immediate Joiner

AI Engineer – GenAI Platform Engineering

Primary Skill: Gen AI Tools

Secondary Skill: Python, Machine Learning, Data Engineering

Tertiary Skill: Hadoop

Minimum Years of Experience: 10

Business Justification

This role is a strategic platform engineering lead responsible for designing and scaling enterprise Generative AI, Data Science, Metadata, Data Quality, and Event-Driven platform capabilities within MALTS. The position will drive self-service AI enablement, platform modernization, and reusable enterprise services that accelerate AI adoption across Consumer, Banking, and Wealth businesses. Ideal candidates possess deep expertise in GenAI, platform engineering, data engineering, distributed systems, governance, and enterprise-scale AI platforms.

Workday Position Summary

This is a senior platform engineering role responsible for architecting, building, and advancing Bank of America’s enterprise-scale Generative AI leveraging Data Science, Event Platform, Data Quality, Metadata, and Data Platform capabilities. The role will help define the strategy, architecture, and engineering standards for next-generation AI and data platforms that enable self-service, governed, and scalable solutions across Consumer, Banking, Wealth, and Enterprise organizations.

The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of reusable enterprise platform services that accelerate AI adoption, data-driven decision making, advanced analytics, agentic workflows, and digital transformation initiatives. This individual will work closely with architects, product owners, engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to build highly scalable, secure, and resilient platforms leveraging cloud-native technologies, distributed computing, modern data architectures, and Generative AI frameworks.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills, a passion for innovation, and the ability to translate complex business needs into enterprise-grade platform capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership, architectural direction, and platform engineering expertise across enterprise Generative AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Event Streaming, Metadata, and Data Quality initiatives.

Design and develop reusable platform services that enable end-to-end self-service AI and data workflows, including data onboarding, data preparation, experimentation, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, governance, and observability.

Define and implement enterprise standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices for scalable AI and data platforms.

Lead the design and delivery of agentic AI applications, intelligent workflows, MCP-enabled services, and event-driven architectures using modern open-source technologies.

Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering teams to gather requirements, evaluate technologies, prototype solutions, and accelerate innovation.

Drive platform modernization initiatives leveraging cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, containers, serverless services, distributed computing, and modern data processing frameworks.

Ensure platform solutions meet enterprise requirements for security, governance, resiliency, scalability, availability, compliance, and operational excellence.

Establish and enforce CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, and DevSecOps practices to improve developer productivity and platform reliability.

Provide technical mentorship, conduct architecture reviews, perform code reviews, and champion engineering excellence across teams.

Own critical technology decisions and communicate architectural direction effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical discipline.

10+ years of hands-on experience designing and building enterprise-scale AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Metadata, Data Quality, and Analytics platforms.

Proven experience architecting and implementing enterprise Generative AI platforms, including LLM integration, agent frameworks, retrieval systems, prompt orchestration, vector-enabled architectures, and AI governance capabilities.

Strong experience building self-service platforms supporting the complete AI/ML lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, experimentation, model development, deployment, inferencing, monitoring, and observability.

Deep understanding of modern AI and data platform architectures, including storage-compute separation, distributed processing, interactive development environments, containerization, and developer productivity tooling.

Experience designing and implementing metadata-driven platforms, semantic layers, data lineage, data quality frameworks, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data governance solutions.

Hands-on expertise with Python and modern AI/ML ecosystems, including open-source frameworks, libraries, and model-serving technologies.

Strong experience designing event-driven and streaming architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Apache Spark, Flink, or equivalent distributed processing frameworks.

Experience building and deploying scalable AI and data workloads on Kubernetes, containers, virtualized infrastructure, and cloud-native environments.

Practical experience developing enterprise-grade APIs, microservices, and distributed systems supporting high-volume data and AI workloads.

Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure automation, and DevSecOps practices using enterprise toolchains.

Strong understanding of platform observability, monitoring, security, governance, reliability, recoverability, and operational excellence.

Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise-wide GenAI ecosystems including AI gateways, model management, prompt management, vector databases, agent orchestration, and responsible AI capabilities.

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic architectures, MCP servers, AI workflow orchestration, and enterprise knowledge platforms.

Strong knowledge of cloud-native AI and data platforms across public and private cloud environments.

Experience with developer platforms, internal AI copilots, self-service data products, and platform product management.

Experience establishing enterprise AI governance, compliance, risk controls, and responsible AI practices.

Demonstrated success leading large-scale platform transformations and modernizing legacy analytics and data science ecosystems.

description:

With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Job Summary
   

  

 The Senior CMDB, Discovery \& Cloud Asset Management Engineer designs, administers, governs, and continuously improves the enterprise CMDB and its discovery, asset\-management, automation, and integration capabilities. The role is a key contributor to Cloud Modernization, with emphasis on scalable AWS/Azure CMDB models, automated cloud onboarding, and reliable asset relationships.
   

  

 The engineer also leads asset\-data quality and lifecycle improvements across Jira Service Management (JSM) Assets, Axonius, Tenable, Lansweeper, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise platforms, partnering with Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application Services, Network, Endpoint, and ITSM teams.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Senior CMDB \& Cloud Asset Management Engineer**
*CMDB \| Discovery \| Cloud Asset Management \| Automation*
**Job Summary**
 The Senior CMDB, Discovery \& Cloud Asset Management Engineer designs, administers, governs, and continuously improves the enterprise CMDB and its discovery, asset\-management, automation, and integration capabilities. The role is a key contributor to Cloud Modernization, with emphasis on scalable AWS/Azure CMDB models, automated cloud onboarding, and reliable asset relationships.
   

  

 The engineer also leads asset\-data quality and lifecycle improvements across Jira Service Management (JSM) Assets, Axonius, Tenable, Lansweeper, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise platforms, partnering with Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application Services, Network, Endpoint, and ITSM teams.
   

  

**Primary Skills**
* Enterprise CMDB architecture, administration, governance, and object\-schema design; Jira/JSM and JSM Assets.
* Axonius, Lansweeper, Tenable, AWS, Azure, discovery, IT asset management, and cloud asset lifecycle management.
* API integrations, workflow automation, data normalization, correlation, reconciliation, deduplication, and reporting.
* ITSM/ITIL configuration\-management practices, application/service mapping, troubleshooting, and stakeholder collaboration.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* CMDB Architecture, Governance \& Data Quality
* Design and maintain CMDB data models, CI classes, attributes, relationships, ownership models, lifecycle states, naming standards, and mandatory data\-quality rules.
* Define authoritative data sources and reconciliation priorities; automate CI creation, updates, validation, certification, archival, and retirement.
* Maintain accurate relationships across applications, services, servers, databases, network devices, endpoints, cloud accounts/resources, and storage services.
* Identify and remediate duplicate, stale, orphaned, incomplete, or inaccurate records; support audits, certification, compliance reviews, and governance reporting.
* Maintain technical documentation for schemas, relationship models, integrations, governance standards, and operational procedures.
* Cloud Modernization \& Cloud CMDB Schema Development \- Priority
* Design a scalable CMDB/JSM Assets model for AWS Organizations, organizational units, accounts, regions, applications, environments, and cloud resources, with reusable onboarding patterns for migration waves.
* Model AWS services including EC2, EBS, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC/network components, load balancers, IAM\-related identities, backup/recovery, storage, and application/platform services.
* Automate onboarding so new AWS accounts and resources are discovered, normalized, reconciled, related, updated, and retired with minimal manual intervention using AWS APIs, AWS Config, Axonius, and approved inventory sources.
* Use stable identifiers such as account IDs, ARNs, regions, and tags; establish required metadata for ownership, application, environment, service, cost center, support group, and lifecycle status.
* Extend object schemas and integrations to Azure, particularly subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, containers, file shares, and related application/service relationships.
* Tenable, Axonius \& Asset Hygiene \- Priority
* Partner with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams to define governed asset inclusion, aging, retention, suppression, pruning, and retirement criteria across Tenable, Axonius, and the CMDB.
* Identify stale, transient, decommissioned, duplicated, incorrectly correlated, unowned, or undiscovered assets while protecting valid assets that are temporarily offline or subject to maintenance cycles.
* Reconcile hostnames, IPs, serial numbers, cloud IDs, agent IDs, operating systems, owners, support groups, and lifecycle states across Tenable, Axonius, CMDB, Lansweeper, endpoint, network, AWS, and Azure sources.
* Automate exception identification, review/approval, remediation, CMDB updates, pruning evidence, and reporting to improve vulnerability\-management coverage and auditability.
* Axonius Automation, Discovery \& Inventory
* Configure and optimize Axonius connectors, queries, correlation rules, dashboards, reports, workflow triggers, notifications, and API\-based automations.
* Monitor connector health, collection schedules, authentication, source coverage, and data freshness; troubleshoot mapping, correlation, synchronization, and automation issues.
* Configure and optimize discovery/inventory solutions, including Lansweeper, and integrate discovery sources with the CMDB for CI creation, updates, relationship mapping, and retirement.
* Improve discovery coverage for remote endpoints, cloud\-hosted workloads, network devices, virtual infrastructure, and segmented environments; manage discovery failures, stale records, duplicates, and unclassified assets.
* Application, Service \& Cloud Storage Mapping
* Maintain business application, technical application, application service, platform service, and infrastructure relationships, including ownership, criticality, support groups, environments, lifecycle states, recovery needs, and service dependencies.
* Map applications and services to AWS/Azure resources, databases, storage, servers, network components, and security assets; keep current\-state and target\-state relationships accurate through cloud migrations and retirements.
* Design and maintain schemas and discovery/reconciliation processes for S3, EBS, Azure Storage accounts, blob containers, file shares, and other approved storage services.
* Identify cloud/storage resources that are unowned, untagged, unused, incorrectly classified, or missing from the CMDB and support lifecycle, migration, audit, and security reporting.
* Jira Service Management, Integration \& Automation
* Configure and enhance Jira/JSM workflows, forms, fields, request types, permissions, notifications, queues, SLAs, automation rules, and JSM Assets schemas to support CMDB, asset, cloud\-onboarding, discovery, and security processes.
* Integrate CMDB, Jira/JSM, Axonius, Lansweeper, Tenable, AWS, Azure, and other systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled imports, scripts, and approved integration platforms.
* Automate cloud CI onboarding, relationship mapping, resource updates/retirement, Axonius\-to\-CMDB synchronization, Tenable/Axonius reconciliation, stale\-asset workflows, duplicate detection, ownership/tag validation, discovery exceptions, and certification/audit reporting.
* Define source\-to\-target mappings, transformation and reconciliation logic, monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, retry processes, access controls, and version\-controlled technical documentation.
* CMDB Health, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Develop dashboards and metrics for completeness, correctness, compliance, uniqueness, freshness, discovery coverage, ownership, relationship completeness, reconciliation success, cloud\-tagging compliance, pruning status, and integration/connector health.
* Establish measurable thresholds and improvement targets; lead root\-cause analysis for recurring data issues and track remediation through completion.
* Provide actionable reporting to technical owners, service owners, management, security, audit, and governance stakeholders.


 Immediate Role Priorities
   

  

* AWS Cloud Modernization: scalable CMDB/JSM Assets schemas, automated onboarding, application/service mapping, and storage visibility for AWS/Azure resources.
* Tenable and Axonius hygiene: governed, auditable pruning/suppression of stale, duplicate, invalid, and decommissioned assets with stronger reconciliation and security coverage.
* Automation and data quality: expand Axonius/Jira/API workflows for ownership, tagging, lifecycle, exceptions, CMDB updates, and measurable health improvements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong experience designing, administering, governing, or improving an enterprise CMDB, including cloud infrastructure and application/service schemas.
* Hands\-on Jira/JSM and JSM Assets (or comparable CMDB/asset platform), plus Axonius connectors, correlation, queries, reporting, and automation.
* Experience with Lansweeper or comparable discovery/inventory tooling and Tenable or another vulnerability\-management platform.
* Working knowledge of AWS account structures, resource types, APIs, tagging, lifecycle management, and cloud governance; relevant Azure infrastructure/storage experience.
* Experience integrating systems through REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled imports, scripts, or automation platforms, with strong data normalization, reconciliation, and deduplication skills.
* Strong ITIL/ITSM, troubleshooting, reporting, documentation, analytical, and cross\-functional stakeholder\-management skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting large\-scale AWS migration/Cloud Modernization; familiarity with AWS Organizations, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Azure subscriptions/resource groups, Azure Resource Graph, and Azure Storage.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Groovy, or similar scripting and with Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Knowledge of service mapping, vulnerability\-management asset lifecycle, regulated/audited environments, and relevant ITIL, Jira, Axonius, AWS, Azure, or asset\-management certifications.


 Measures of Success
   

  

* Standardized, scalable cloud CMDB schemas and automated AWS onboarding with minimal manual intervention.
* Improved alignment across CMDB, Axonius, Tenable, Lansweeper, AWS, and Azure, with measurable reductions in duplicate, stale, orphaned, unowned, and untagged assets.
* Governed asset pruning, stronger discovery/security coverage and application\-to\-cloud relationships, reduced manual effort through automation, and improved CMDB health and stakeholder confidence.

 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring \& resolution in large\-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi\-vendor infrastructures.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on\-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS\-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
   

  

 What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
   

  

 Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re\-checks.** 
 You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
   

  

**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.** 
 Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
   

  

 Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
   

  

**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi\-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high\-fan\-out integration reliability; multi\-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10\+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go\-to\-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote\-first, most of that happens in writing.


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
